"Operative apocalypse" refers to either an academic/theological theory regarding the Book of Revelation as the chronological seed of the New Testament, or a satirical concept used by worker-owned cooperatives to describe the fight against climate change and corporate greed.The term spans two distinct contexts:1. Cooperative & Climate ActivismThe phrase is also used as a satirical nod by cooperative organizations and collectives attempting to mitigate environmental collapse.Core Argument: Workers' co-ops represent a functional protest against profit-driven capitalism.
